scope: Task-owned CLI diagnostics, bootstrap templates, docs, native CI and test evidence
compatibility: No changes to approval, digest, protocol, rollback or final JSON. Downloads measured from received file bytes; opaque workers show elapsed activity.
limitations: Old initiating binaries do not gain telemetry retroactively. Native CI required before canonical closure; Mac ARM, real WSL and real agent sessions are unverified. Raw child output is captured rather than streamed. No merge, version bump, tag or release.
